gaps.sentence: You needn't ___ worried — everything is fine.
It was ___ a good film that we saw it twice.
He must ___ left already — his coat isn't here.
gaps.explanation: 'must have + participle' = certain about the past.

gaps.sentence: ___ of the two passwords works — try the other one.
gaps.hint: not one and not the other
gaps.explanation: 'Neither of the two' = not either of them.

gaps.sentence: The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.
'such an + adjective + singular noun' — 'interesting' starts with a vowel sound.

gaps.sentence: He denied the charge, but the jury found him ___ after only an hour.
gaps.explanation: 'But' signals a contrast with his denial: the jury found him guilty.
